caption: James Harden scored 51 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Indiana Pacers 128-119 in the NBA Cup. It was his 26th 50-point game, passing Kobe Bryant for third-most in NBA history.

beats.caption: James Harden scored 51 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Indiana Pacers 128-119 in an NBA Cup game.

beats.label: JAMES HARDEN POINTS
beats.caption: Harden shot 15-of-26 from the field, including 7-of-11 from three-point range.

beats.label: JAMES HARDEN FREE THROWS
beats.caption: He also made all 14 of his free throws, adding six rebounds and six assists.

beats.label: CAREER 50-POINT GAMES
beats.caption: It was the 26th 50-point game of his career, passing Kobe Bryant for third-most in NBA history.

beats.text: ONLY WILT CHAMBERLAIN AND MICHAEL JORDAN HAVE MORE
beats.caption: Only Wilt Chamberlain (118) and Michael Jordan (31) have more 50-point games than James Harden.
